summary.text: Joe Jock, a Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 3rd District to Hillary Scholten.

He advanced from the party's convention on July 18, 2026, and in his Ballotpedia survey described himself as a working-class Michigander, a father and an ordinary citizen, and said he was not a career politician.
He received 1.4% of the vote to Hillary Scholten's 57.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2026
